title: Golden Siddhivinayak Ganesha
description: A magnificent golden mudra Ganesha murti symbolizing intellectual heights, focus, and obstacle extraction.

title: Meditation Ganapati under Sacred Arch
description: Finely-crafted temple stone structure depiction of Sri Vinayaka in absolute yogic stasis.

title: Supreme Adiyogi Lord Shiva
description: Vedic depiction of Adiyogi Lord Shiva meditating, holding the sacred trishool of truth.

title: Dhyana Shiva overlooking Ganges
description: Celestial blue depiction of Shiva holding his damru, showing the crescent moon on his head.

title: Lord Krishna with Mystic Murali
description: Shyamasundara Krishna playing the divine flute, adorned with an elegant peacock feather.

title: Radha Krishna Divine Monsoon Love
description: A traditional artistic painting portraying the celestial bond between Sri Radha and Bhagavan Krishna.

title: Ma Durga Goddess Mahishasuramardini
description: Ma Durga seated on her sacred lion, wielding standard weapons of light, vanquisher of demonic egos.

title: Ayodhya Sri Rama with Kodanda Bow
description: A magnificent depiction of Ram Lalla holding his cosmic Kodanda bow, radiating gentle righteousness.

title: Sankat Mochan Lord Hanuman
description: Hanuman in deep meditative prayer chanting 'Ram Ram', radiating humility and limitless power.

title: Veenavadini Goddess Saraswati
description: Goddess of arts holding the spiritual Veena of intellectual harmony, seated on her pristine white swan of discrimination.
